{{Top|leg}}
A '''fast-target compensator''' was a part of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial gunner/Legends|gunner's]] computerized helmet. They were combined with [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] arrays and a [[Macrobinocular viewplate/Legends|macrobinocular viewplate]] to assist gunners in performance of their duty.
